mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the largest land animals and are among the longest lived, with life spans of 60 years or more."
Elephants are the largest land animals and are among the longest lived, with life spans of 60 years or more.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an herbivore; it eats leaves, herbs, twigs and plants like cabbage, clover or the bark of trees."
The common porcupine is an herbivore; it eats leaves, herbs, twigs and plants like cabbage, clover or the bark of trees.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred to as amniota because they have an amniotic membrane."
The reptiles and mammals are referred to as amniota because they have an amniotic membrane.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the largest living species of bird and lays the largest egg of any living bird."
The Ostrich is the largest living species of bird and lays the largest egg of any living bird.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the third largest of the rodents (63-91 cm long; 5.4-16 kg), behind the capybara and the beaver."
Porcupines are the third largest of the rodents (63-91 cm long; 5.4-16 kg), behind the capybara and the beaver.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a group of small to medium-sized brightly coloured birds in the order Coraciiformes."
Kingfishers are a group of small to medium-sized brightly coloured birds in the order Coraciiformes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the most distinctive and highly specialised orders of mammals."
The Cetacea are one of the most distinctive and highly specialised orders of mammals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the largest of the three species of elephants."
The Savanna Elephant (Loxodonta africana) is the largest of the three species of elephants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the few mammals (other than primates) that have fingerprints very similar to human fingerprints."
The koala is one of the few mammals (other than primates) that have fingerprints very similar to human fingerprints.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the scientific study of the areas where different animals live and the causes and effects of such distribution, especially distributions on a large or global scale."
Zoogeography may be defined as the scientific study of the areas where different animals live and the causes and effects of such distribution, especially distributions on a large or global scale.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the smallest species, weighing less than 20 grams and measuring just 12 to 15 cm."
Quails are the smallest species, weighing less than 20 grams and measuring just 12 to 15 cm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the largest extant rodent in the world (weighing up to 91 kg)."
The capybara (Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris) is the largest extant rodent in the world (weighing up to 91 kg).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only mammal naturally capable of true and sustained flight."
The bat is the only mammal naturally capable of true and sustained flight.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered as turtles that inhabit land and have un-webbed feet unlike the water turtle that live most of the lives in water and have webbed feet."
Tortoises are considered as turtles that inhabit land and have un-webbed feet unlike the water turtle that live most of the lives in water and have webbed feet.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called joey and is born during the early stage of development (just after a month) akin to premature birth."
The young of metatherians is called joey and is born during the early stage of development (just after a month) akin to premature birth.
fib: ______ are a large and remarkably diverse group of mammals.
artiodactyls
The artiodactyls are a large and remarkably diverse group of mammals.
______ is regarded as the first set of fish with jaws but are now extinct.
class Placodermi
The class Placodermi is regarded as the first set of fish with jaws but are now extinct.
______ refers to the food habit of the group as a whole.
name Insectivora (insect eater)
name Insectivora
The name Insectivora (insect eater) refers to the food habit of the group as a whole.
______ is an animal with a pouch, like a kangaroo or a koala.
marsupial
A marsupial is an animal with a pouch, like a kangaroo or a koala.
______ are considered primitive because their placenta-like structure is poorly developed and its function is complemented by a yolk sac as in reptiles.
metatherians
The metatherians are considered primitive because their placenta-like structure is poorly developed and its function is complemented by a yolk sac as in reptiles.
______ is a national symbol of New Zealand.
Kiwi
Kiwi is a national symbol of New Zealand.
______ is the Warbler Finch and the largest is the Vegetarian Finch.
smallest
The smallest is the Warbler Finch and the largest is the Vegetarian Finch.
______ are a medium sized group of marine animals commonly referred to as Sea squirts, Tunicates, Salps or Larvaceans.
Urochordates
Urochordates are a medium sized group of marine animals commonly referred to as Sea squirts, Tunicates, Salps or Larvaceans.
______ are an obscure group of animals, which unlike the acorn worms; form colonies in which the individuals are interconnected by stems, or stolons.
pterobranchs
The pterobranchs are an obscure group of animals, which unlike the acorn worms; form colonies in which the individuals are interconnected by stems, or stolons.
______ is composed of four orders namely Order Crocodilia (crocodiles and alligators), Order Testudinata (turtles), Order Squamata (lizards and snakes) and Order Rhynchocephalia (Tuataras).
Class Reptilia

The Class Reptilia is composed of four orders namely Order Crocodilia (crocodiles and alligators), Order Testudinata (turtles), Order Squamata (lizards and snakes) and Order Rhynchocephalia (Tuataras).
______ are regarded as cold-blooded animals because they do not have a constant body temperature but instead take on the temperature of their environment.
Amphibians
Amphibians are regarded as cold-blooded animals because they do not have a constant body temperature but instead take on the temperature of their environment.
______ is a collective name for several genera of mid-sized birds generally considered in the order Galliformes.
Quail
Quail is a collective name for several genera of mid-sized birds generally considered in the order Galliformes.
______ are the most advanced protochordates, clearly showing the four primary features of chordates (notochord, dorsal nerve cord, pharyngeal gill slits and post anal tail) throughout their life.
cephalochordates

The cephalochordates are the most advanced protochordates, clearly showing the four primary features of chordates (notochord, dorsal nerve cord, pharyngeal gill slits and post anal tail) throughout their life.
______ is the largest order of reptiles with over 6,000 living species.
Order Squamata (meaning scaled reptiles)
Order Squamata
The Order Squamata (meaning scaled reptiles) is the largest order of reptiles with over 6,000 living species.
